reason: My architect already produces 3D models and renders inside their fee, so I'd be paying twice for something I already get. And I bill cost-plus, so a new line item means the homeowner has to sign off on it.
objection: The architect already covers renders, and the homeowner would have to agree to pay for a second visualization on top of the architecture line.
would_change_my_mind: If it replaced work my architect is already charging for, so the homeowner's total went down or stayed flat, or if it was clearly shown to cut change orders on a job I could point to.
